title: Auto-nnU-Net: Towards Automated Medical Image Segmentation
mechanism: Adds hyperparameter optimisation, NAS and hierarchical NAS to nnU-Net, using Regularized PriorBand (multi-fidelity, cost-aware) to trade accuracy against training cost.
adaptation: Search over lr, momentum, foreground oversampling ratio, crack/inactive loss weights, deep-supervision weights, encoder depth/width and augmentation set (default vs label-safe). Objective = CV mean of crack relF1@2 + inactive IoU on the module-grouped folds; multi-fidelity over 8 A6000.
min_experiment: One PriorBand run with a 300 GPU-h budget; evaluate the incumbent once on test-49 and E1 against the nnU-Net label-safe arm. Kill: under +0.01 CV objective over the default config.
evidence: R: improved nnU-Net on 6 of 10 Medical Segmentation Decathlon tasks and tied the other 4, at practical resource cost.
prior_overlap: none. Past loss and optimizer variations were one-at-a-time on the house recipe, never a joint search.
